svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two bought bolt-up clamp collars: 31.8 mm for the seat tube and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 29.8 mm for the sleeve (it closes onto the 29.2 sleeve).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill and tap one radial M5 hole in each, square to the bore, half way

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: up (7 below the top), a quarter turn from the clamp bolt.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seat tube collar: hole on the LEFT. Sleeve collar: hole on the RIGHT.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stop screws: M5 x 10 with a dog point. Seat tube one: grind its tip so

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: it enters the sleeve slot 1.5 mm and never touches the post.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sleeve one: tip enters the post slot about 1.5 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: each collar sits flush with the top of its tube, slit at the back,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its stop hole lined up with the hole in the tube under it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: with the screw in, the part inside slides to both slot ends

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and stops; the collar bolt closes the tube without the screw binding.
